goal: Second write-back batch: fold the 75 unit candidates that are recalled in all five remaining source documents (Books 2-6) across 15 entity groups into 15 canonical knowledge units, and record how every duplicate candidate was resolved.

inputs.source_scope: six books only (Books 1-6); Books 7+ out of scope by user instruction

scope.group_rule: unit candidates recalled in five source documents (doc_count = 5) and passing cross-source alias review
scope.excluded_neighbour_group: xdup-0012 (荀子) has doc_count = 4 and is not a five-book group; left pending for a later batch

method.semantic_step: Per-group cross-source re-read of all five Markdown sources plus targeted line verification; every source disagreement (dates, counts, name spellings, site identifications, technique origins) was kept as an explicit variance note instead of being resolved by preference.
method.canonical_rule: One canonical candidate per group is promoted to a knowledge unit; the remaining four same-name candidates transition to rejected with a reason naming the canonical target.
method.state_chain: needs_evidence -> ready_for_review -> approved -> applied for canonical; needs_evidence -> rejected for duplicates.
method.ledger: Append-only candidate-decision-ledger.jsonl; historical R1 candidate ledgers untouched.
method.write_back: Typed exact change-set: 15 create actions, no update or delete.

source_variance_notes: 中央工艺美术学院: 副院长用字 庞薰琍 (2009) / 庞薰杲 (2016); 附设机构 中央工艺美术研究所 / 中央工艺美术科学研究所.
少府监: 玄宗时工匠数 八百多人 (田自秉) vs 少府监与将作监各万余人 (夏燕靖 2009/2016).
宋应星: 《天工开物》成书/刊行 1636 (李立新) vs 1637 (高丰/赵农/夏燕靖 2016).
磁州窑: 元代地位 衰落 (高丰) vs 元代名窑且元初设官窑课税 (夏燕靖 2016).
邢窑: 主要窑址 至今尚未发现 (夏燕靖 2009/2016) vs 1980 年临城普查发现唐窑址 (田自秉).
失蜡法: 出现上限 春秋早中期 (高丰) vs 春秋晚期至战国 (夏燕靖 2009/2016).
园冶: 成稿 1631 / 刊行 1634 (夏燕靖 2016) vs 泛称明末 (赵农).
髹饰录: 作者 黄成 (高丰) vs 黄大成 (田自秉); 成书 隆庆年间 (高丰) vs 天启年间 (夏燕靖 2016).
唐三彩: 器类 四大类 (高丰) vs 三类 (田自秉); 烧成 一次约 900℃ (高丰) vs 素烧 1000-1100℃ 加釉烧 900℃ (夏燕靖).
彩陶: 夏燕靖 2009 “也称仰韶文化”的表述在 2016 版被自注为倒置; 五型划分仅田自秉给出.
明式家具: 用材清单与六大类器类划分仅部分来源给出; 概念史 (杨耀, 1930 年代) 仅高丰记录.
缂丝: 田自秉书该节标题原文误作“绯丝”, 正文作“缂丝”; 本批按正文统一.
陵阳公样: 人名 窦师伦 (高丰) vs 窦师纶 (田自秉/李立新); 母题 对雉 (高丰) vs 对鸡 (田自秉); 2016 原文误作“对风”.

semantic_change.confidence_posture: All fifteen units are confidence=medium, consensus=tentative, evidence_status=source_backed. No unit is marked confirmed, externally verified, or L1-L7 verified.

validation.apply_plan_hash_check: all 15 rows verified against disk (sha256, bytes, lines)
